Import environmental data from CSV

Source: R/imports.R
from_csv.Rd

Reads a CSV file and converts it directly to an `env_schema` object.

Usage

from_csv(
  path,
  location,
  date,
  analyte,
  result,
  unit = NULL,
  sample_id = NULL,
  reporting_flag = NULL,
  reporting_limit = NULL,
  detection_limit = NULL,
  quantitation_limit = NULL,
  achieved_mdc = NULL,
  measurement_uncertainty = NULL,
  method = NULL,
  analysis_date = NULL,
  matrix = NULL,
  lab_name = NULL,
  metadata = NULL,
  date_format = c("guess", "mdy", "dmy", "ymd"),
  qualifier_table = NULL,
  analyte_lookup = analyte_tbl
)

Arguments

path

Path to csv file.

location

Location identifier column.

date

Sample date column.

analyte

Analyte column.

result

Result column.

unit

Unit column.

sample_id

Sample identifier column.

reporting_flag

Reporting qualifier column.

reporting_limit

Reporting limit column.

detection_limit

Detection limit column.

quantitation_limit

Quantitation limit column (PQL, LOQ, SQL, etc.).

achieved_mdc

Achieved minimum detectable concentration (radiochemistry).

measurement_uncertainty

Measurement uncertainty column.

method

Analytical method column.

analysis_date

Analysis date column.

matrix

Matrix column.

lab_name

Laboratory name column.

metadata

Additional metadata columns.

date_format

Date format.

qualifier_table

Optional qualifier lookup.

analyte_lookup

Optional analyte lookup.

Value

env_schema

Details

Column mappings use tidy evaluation and may reference any column names present in the source file.
